title: Atlantic article on Obama briefing, edited wording
place_text: F.E. Warren Air Force Base, Wyoming

tellings.quote: October of 2010 the Atlantic wrote a pretty telling article it says and I quote President Obama was briefed this morning on a power failure at Fe Warren

plain: In October 2010 The Atlantic published an article saying, in Michels's quotation, that "President Obama was briefed this morning on a power failure at F.E. Warren," an Air Force base in Wyoming that controls nuclear missiles. Michels reads it out himself in an episode with the researcher Robert Hastings about UFOs near nuclear bases, calling it a "pretty telling article" and drawing attention to how it was worded. The article as he quotes it speaks of a power failure and a presidential briefing; whether UFOs had anything to do with that outage, the quoted words neither say nor rule out.
